question: With how many wooden pieces may the twice-born construct the element?
premises: Alternatively it may use one piece.
The material is wood and the instruction addresses the twice-born.
inference: O twice-born, one should make it with two wooden pieces or with one.
uncertainties: The fused form dārubhyāndāruṇādvijāḥ contains compressed sandhi.
plain_english: O twice-born, one should make it with two pieces of wood or with one.
